description: This Java class 'LoanBalanceService' provides various methods for calculating and updating the balances, overpayments, outstanding amounts, and schedules related to loan accounts. It contains logic for handling transactions, refunds, overpayments, and repayment schedules within a loan management system, utilizing domain-specific classes and services.
external_methods: Fees and penalty related: isDueInPeriod, getAmount, getAmountWaived, getAmountPaid, getinstallmentLoanCharge

classes.name: LoanBalanceService
classes.description: Service class responsible for calculating and updating loan balance related metrics, such as overpayments, outstanding balances, and repayment schedules.

methods.name: calculateTotalOverpayment
methods.description: Calculates the total amount of overpayment for a given loan by subtracting the sum of payments scheduled and made, considering refunds and chargebacks.

methods.name: isOverPaid
methods.description: Returns true if the loan has been overpaid based on the total overpayment calculation.

methods.name: updateLoanSummaryDerivedFields
methods.description: Updates the derived fields of the loan summary, such as total overpaid and recovered, and refreshes balances.

methods.name: refreshSummaryAndBalancesForDisbursedLoan
methods.description: Recalculates and updates balances, overpayment, and recovered amounts for a disbursed loan.

methods.name: calculateTotalRecoveredPayments
methods.description: Calculates the total recovered (paid back) amount for a loan based on transactions.

methods.name: updateLoanOutstandingBalances
methods.description: Recomputes and updates the outstanding balances for each transaction related to the loan.

methods.name: updateLoanToLastDisbursalState
methods.description: Adjusts the loan state and charges to the last disbursal point, including resetting overdue charges.

methods.name: getReceivableInterest
methods.description: Calculates the interest that is receivable up to a specified date for a given loan.

methods.name: fetchLoanForeclosureDetail
methods.description: Retrieves a schedule installment detail for loan foreclosure based on outstanding income.

methods.name: retrieveIncomeForOverlappingPeriod
methods.description: Calculates interest, fees, and penalties for a period overlapping with the repayment schedule.

methods.name: retrieveIncomeOutstandingTillDate
methods.description: Retrieves outstanding income, interest, fees, and penalties up to a specified date.

methods.name: fetchInterestFeeAndPenaltyTillDate
methods.description: Fetches interest, fee, and penalty charges for a specific period within the schedule.
